item.title: Implement token-bucket rate limiter per SPEC.md in ratelimit.py
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py, which currently only has stubs. Follow the spec exactly, including its error cases and edge cases; test_ratelimit.py only covers the basics, so add tests for the spec's error and edge cases. Use the standard library only, no dependencies. Commit the work. Operator words: "Implement the rate limiter described in SPEC.md in ratelimit.py (the module currently only has stubs). Follow the spec exactly, including its error cases and edge cases; the tests in test_ratelimit.py only cover the basics. Keep it dependency-free (standard library only) and commit your work."

model_reasons.implement: Single-module change with a written spec; medium effort covers the edge cases without a costly model.

Committed as 8802b7a on archon/bnx8f8b2-implement-token-bucket-rate-limiter-per (tree 6f7ac306b4e76d6e66a50e7fd4c3a7da4a665588), not pushed. Before: the 3 original tests errored on the stubs. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M7W6KGDS06CPRGHVCZ9SM8MT, claude-haiku-5-5, medium) passed the head with no blocking findings and confirmed risk medium. evidence.caption: Before: the original test file run against the stubs

pr.body: Approach: ratelimit.py implements TokenBucket (refill on each call from an injected monotonic clock; a backwards clock adds nothing until it passes the latest time seen) and KeyedLimiter (OrderedDict of buckets, LRU via move_to_end, eviction before insert, request validation before any key is created or evicted). Key files: ratelimit.py, test_ratelimit.py. Checks: python3 -W error -m unittest -v test_ratelimit, 25 tests OK. Assumptions and extensions: capacity and refill_per_sec must be finite and > 0; max_keys must be an int >= 1. Known limits: floating-point token arithmetic; not thread-safe. Review follow-ups (non-blocking): misleading test name at test_request_size_must_be_within_one_and_capacity; TypeError for non-numeric rates; bool accepted as max_keys; no default max_keys test; clock-backwards not tested through KeyedLimiter.
pr.summary: Made rate limiting possible: TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter, stdlib only. Before: stubs raising NotImplementedError. Now: buckets start full, refill continuously, reject invalid params, and KeyedLimiter evicts LRU keys at max_keys.
pr.title: Implement token-bucket rate limiter per SPEC.md

risk.why: New public module with no callers, no concurrency or security surface. Defines API with subtle refill and LRU semantics, so medium. Only ratelimit.py and test_ratelimit.py change. Reviewer confirmed medium with no blocking findings.
